title: PackedDataset
description: The token sequences of a Dataset under a Tokenizer, the input of masked-language-model batches (epic:bert-from-scratch, "sequence packing"). `modelspec data pack --dataset <dir> --tokenizer <file> --seq-len <S> --out <dir>` encodes the documents of each split in order (a document as DatasetSplit.document_count defines it), joins them with `[SEP]` (id 3) between two documents and no `[CLS]`, and cuts the stream into sequences of S consecutive ids with no regard to document boundaries, the partial tail dropped, so no sequence needs padding. It writes `train.tokens`, `heldout.tokens` (PackedSplit), the TrainingDataBinding as `binding.json` and this record as `packed.json` in `<dir>`; two runs on the same inputs write byte-identical output. packed_id is the leading 16 bytes, as a version-8 UUID, of the blake3 hash over the 32-byte blake3 digests of the packed files, Train then HeldOut, and seq_len as 8 little-endian bytes, in that order, so two sequence lengths that cut the same ids give two ids (coordinator decision D29, 2026-10-25, `.engineering/waves/bert-1.md`, amending D26). Data order of a run with seed s and batch size B over the n Train sequences - epoch e visits them ascending by the 64-bit key w1 × 2^32 + w0 of the Philox block of counter [i, 5, e as u32, (e >> 32) as u32] under seed s for sequence i, ties by i (stream tag 5, DESIGN.md § 2.3); step k is batch k mod ⌊n / B⌋ of epoch ⌊k / ⌊n / B⌋⌋, batch b taking positions b × B to (b + 1) × B - 1 of the order, so an incomplete last batch is never used. The HeldOut split is read in stored order, step k taking batch k mod ⌊n / B⌋ (coordinator decision D26, 2026-10-24, `.engineering/waves/bert-1.md`).

seq_len.description: The number of tokens of every sequence, the binding's seq_len (coordinator decision D26, 2026-10-24, `.engineering/waves/bert-1.md`).

vocabulary_size.description: The number of tokens of the tokenizer's vocabulary, V; every id of a packed file lies in [0, V), a random substitution draws from [5, V) and the baseline smooths over the V - 5 tokens that are not special. Added so a batch and the baseline can be computed from the packed directory alone (coordinator decision D26, 2026-10-24, `.engineering/waves/bert-1.md`).

heldout_unigram_baseline_nats.description: The cross-entropy, in nats, of the tokens of the packed HeldOut split that are not special under the unigram frequencies of the packed Train split with add-one smoothing, -(1 / M) Σ ln((c(t) + 1) / (C + V - 5)) over the M held-out tokens t, where c(t) counts t among the C Train tokens that are not special; the target of pre-training is measured against it (story:bert-tiny-gpu-pretraining; coordinator decision D26, 2026-10-24, `.engineering/waves/bert-1.md`).

modelspec.artifact.ContentHash.title: ContentHash
modelspec.artifact.ContentHash.description: A blake3 digest under explicit serialization and version rules (DESIGN.md § 7).

modelspec.data.PackedSplit.title: PackedSplit
modelspec.data.PackedSplit.description: One split of a PackedDataset, the file `train.tokens` for Train and `heldout.tokens` for HeldOut, little-endian `i32` token ids with no header, sequence_count × seq_len values (coordinator decision D26, 2026-10-24, `.engineering/waves/bert-1.md`).

sequence_count.description: The number of sequences of seq_len tokens the split's token stream holds, its partial tail dropped. A split whose stream is shorter than one sequence is refused (coordinator decision D26, 2026-10-24, `.engineering/waves/bert-1.md`).

content_hash.description: The blake3 hash of the split's packed file, 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits (coordinator decision D26, 2026-10-24, `.engineering/waves/bert-1.md`).

modelspec.data.SplitRole.title: SplitRole
modelspec.data.SplitRole.description: What a split is used for; MLM loss and accuracy are evaluated on the held-out split (epic:bert-from-scratch).
